meta.aciklama:
OpenDesign is an open-source design agent workspace with over 100K stars on GitHub.

You give it a brief and the coding agent you already use builds the prototype.

It doesn't ship its own agent. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other agent CLIs on your machine are the design engine. Swap them in one click. The prototype follows your design system. You get a live preview in the studio, plus slides and image generation.

What comes out is real HTML and CSS you can keep building in your code editor, or you can export to PPTX, PDF or MP4. Desktop apps are out for macOS and Windows, and it's Apache 2.0.

The catch: the hosted OpenDesign Cloud and its credit plans cost money. The open-source app is free, you bring your own agent and keys.

Repo: https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design

Save this if you design with AI agents.

#aidesign #claudecode #opensource
